# block number

The sequential number of a ledger block.

Use [`gmeow:blockNumber`](gmeow-blockNumber.md) from [`gmeow:Block`](../classes/gmeow-Block.md) to [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Block`](../classes/gmeow-Block.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the height/ordinal number of a [`gmeow:Block`](../classes/gmeow-Block.md) — its position in the chain, the figure confirmation depth is measured against.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the block's cryptographic identity ([`gmeow:blockHash`](gmeow-blockHash.md)) or a transaction/event index within a block ([`gmeow:logIndex`](gmeow-logIndex.md)); the block number is chain height, not a hash or an in-block offset. Functional — one number per block.

### How to use

- Set one integer height on the [`gmeow:Block`](../classes/gmeow-Block.md) alongside [`gmeow:blockHash`](gmeow-blockHash.md); [`gmeow:confirmationDepth`](gmeow-confirmationDepth.md) is then computed in the solver layer as the difference from the current chain tip.

### Examples

- ex:block42 [`gmeow:blockNumber`](gmeow-blockNumber.md) 42.
